ui_source_ref: Modern, premium e-commerce mobile app. Primary navy blue (#0A1F44 / #14213D), gold/amber accent (#D4AF37) or coral for product cards and CTA buttons. White/light gray background (#F8F9FA), cards with navy border or navy header. Large product images, clean grid layout. Clean sans-serif font (Inter/Poppins). Rounded corners (12-16px), soft shadow — luxury, trustworthy, minimal. Cart, checkout, product detail pages with navy accents, clean, generous whitespace.
